revenue.label: Revenue (₦)
revenue.description: Net of trade discount, excludes VAT.

gross_profit.label: Gross profit (₦)
gross_profit.description: Revenue minus units × standard unit cost.

gross_margin_pct.label: Gross margin (%)
gross_margin_pct.description: Gross profit as a share of revenue.

stockout_rate_pct.label: Stockout rate (%)
stockout_rate_pct.description: Share of depot-SKU-weeks flagged as stocked out.

promo_share_pct.label: Promo revenue share (%)
promo_share_pct.sql: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN on_promotion = 1 THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_ngn), 0)
promo_share_pct.description: Share of revenue sold on promotion.

avg_discount_pct.label: Average promo discount (%)
avg_discount_pct.sql: 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN on_promotion = 1 THEN discount_pct END)

active_skus.label: Active SKUs
active_skus.description: SKUs with at least one sale record.
